rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of Templates.jsx crash: when E1 added the new BspStatusPill component + BSP_STYLE constant to Templates.jsx, the original Templates() component's closing `);` (return) and `}` (function) were removed/skipped, causing the parser to encounter `const BSP_STYLE` inside a still-open JSX return. Webpack treated this as a syntax error and refused to compile, dark-screening every page. Fix: insert `);` + `}` between the final `` and `const BSP_STYLE = {` (lines 116-117). Then trim the duplicated trailing `);}` block at EOF that was orphaned. Confirmed via clean compile + all 9 routes loading.
